propose_reads_prefix_only.impact: Facts appearing after character 12,000 (middle, final, late table) are never proposed for wiki extraction.

session_extract_clips_prefix.impact: Content after character 32,000 is truncated with truncated=true and omitted from session-only text.

retrieve_clips_item_prefix.impact: Individual items returned by retrieve-bundle clip at 4,000 chars, dropping later passage context.

word_extraction_flattens_structure.impact: extract-docx.ts extracts plain w:t tags without headings, tables, or footnotes.

upload_bytes_discarded.impact: Original uploaded file is unlinked immediately after conversion; original bytes not preserved.

in_process_mutex_insufficient.impact: createMutex in library-lock.ts is an in-process Promise map; cannot coordinate cross-process companion/workers.

format_routing_baseline.md_txt: Preserved UTF-8; full file written to raw/
format_routing_baseline.docx: Flattened to plain paragraphs; footnotes/headings omitted
format_routing_baseline.xlsx: Sheet tables converted; uncached formulas empty
format_routing_baseline.csv: Parsed with csv.reader; quoted commas preserved
format_routing_baseline.pptx: Rejected by current product entry; requires optional python-pptx
format_routing_baseline.pdf_text: Extracted via pypdf/markitdown; CID-font Chinese supported
format_routing_baseline.pdf_mixed: Page 1 extracted, page 2 image dropped without warning
